entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Charlie. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to make a return. I have a VeloBand tracker.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Um, yes, it's VF88602. I just... I feel so overwhelmed by it. It's really confusing.

Okay, order VF88602. I see it was delivered on December 15th. I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue with how it works?

I guess it's a preference? It just feels so hard to use. I read the user manual, but nothing makes sense. I just expected more from it, you know? It's not tracking my pulse the way I thought it would. Can't you just help me? I'd rather just send it back.
I understand your frustration. It's no problem at all. Let me just pull up our return policy to check on the eligibility for you. Please hold one moment.
Alright, thank you for waiting. I've reviewed your order and our policy, and it looks like you are unfortunately outside the 10-day return window.
Oh, really? I thought I might have waited too long. That's a relief. So I can return it for a refund?

Absolutely. I've just initiated the return for you. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file right now. Just place the VeloBand and all its accessories back in the original box, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
Wow, that's great. Thank you so much, Charlie. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your full refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can do for you today?
No, that was everything. Thanks again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
